events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary artist and peace activist, John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His impact on music and culture remains as powerful as ever.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedic legend John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today, born in 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Icon
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly timeless.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: Iconic White Album
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles unleashed their sprawling, genre-bending 'White Album' upon the world. A truly revolutionary record that still sounds fresh.

events.title: 35 years since Freddie Mercury's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the world lost the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away in 1991.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years on, the voice and stage presence of Freddie Mercury remain unmatched. Remembering the legendary showman today.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Milestone
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that marked a significant shift in their sound and songwriting. A true masterpiece.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today is the 46th anniversary of the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: A poignant day as we remember John Lennon, who left us 46 years ago. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary David Bowie was born on this day in 1947, and would have celebrated his 80th birthday.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Celebrating the Starman. David Bowie would have turned 80 today, and his unparalleled artistry continues to resonate across the universe.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935, and would have been 92.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King still reigns supreme.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock icon Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today, born in 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his riffs defined generations.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer-songwriter, celebrates his 82nd birthday today, born in 1945.

angles.name: Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, turning 82 today! Still rockin' and rollin' after all these years.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs from Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday today, born in 1961.

angles.name: Our Favourite Nutty Boy
angles.copy: Happy 66th Birthday to Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house down with those classic ska anthems.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday today, born in 1956.

angles.name: Wherever I Lay My Hat
angles.copy: Happy 71st Birthday to Paul Young! That smooth voice defined the 80s for so many of us.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday today, born in 1946.

angles.name: Queen of Country
angles.copy: Happy 81st Birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! An icon, a songwriter, and a true force of nature. What a woman!

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today, born in 1971.

angles.name: Mr. Take That
angles.copy: Happy 56th Birthday to Gary Barlow! From boyband heartthrob to songwriting maestro, he's done it all.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday today, born in 1950.

angles.name: Get Outta My Dreams
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to Billy Ocean! Still making us want to 'Get Outta My Dreams, Get Into My Car' every time.

events.title: 38 years since first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the first induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held, honouring legends like Chuck Berry and Elvis Presley.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: It's been 38 years since the first Rock & Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who would be your first pick if you were starting one today?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today, born in 1972.

angles.name: Mark's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 55th Birthday to Take That's very own Mark Owen! Still got that boyish charm.
